answer_1.quote: We evaluate QuZO on five widely-used commonsense reasoning benchmarks under the zero-shot setting using the LLaMA-3 8B model fine-tuned with our method.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers in zero-shot or few-shot settings for commonsense reasoning and language understanding tasks, including multiple-choice and open-ended QA.
